title: Modern Educayshun
summary: Neel Kolhatkar's satirical short film parodies modern education and political correctness. It shows how obsession with inclusive speech makes plain communication difficult.
why: It is cited as a comedic parody of diversity and inclusion initiatives in threads on those topics.

quote.text: A short-film/parody on how an extreme obsession with inclusive speech makes it impossible to communicate clearly without consequences.
